name: A Grim Discovery
summary: In Orgrimmar, Belgrom Rockmaul awaits the Grimtotem horns and your account of Feralas. Krueg Skullsplitter says you did the work and deserve the best of the bounty. This follows the first A Grim Discovery.

sections.title: The Crate of Horns
sections.body: Krueg Skullsplitter admits he spoke of a bounty after the first A Grim Discovery. You did the work, so he believes you deserve the best of the payoff. He packs the horns into a crate for you to carry to Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor. Belgrom wants to hear what you saw, and Krueg says he will make your hard work worth it.

sections.title: Belgrom's Interest
sections.body: Belgrom Rockmaul is struck by news of the Grimtotem. He asks whether you truly met them while hunting in Feralas. His peers will want to hear the story, so he asks you to tell him more as the coin is counted out. Belgrom thanks you for the information.

faq.q: Who gives this part of A Grim Discovery?
faq.answer: Krueg Skullsplitter gives you the horns in a crate to carry to Belgrom Rockmaul.

faq.q: Where does the crate of Grimtotem horns go?
aliases: where do i take the horns
faq.answer: The crate of Grimtotem horns goes to Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Krueg says you did the work, so you deserve the best of the payoff.

faq.q: What does Belgrom want from you?
faq.answer: Your report of what you saw. Krueg promises that your hard work will be worth it.
The first A Grim Discovery comes before this part. You brought Krueg Grimtotem horns.
